en.faq.3: How much does Core Spark Web cost?
en.faq.5: How long until it's up and running?
en.faq.6: Up and running in 7 days from when you give us your business information.
en.faq.7: Do I need to have a website?
en.faq.8: No. Core Spark Web is for starting from scratch: we build the whole website with the agent built in. If you already have a website, Spark is a better fit.
en.faq.9: Does the agent make up answers?
en.faq.10: No. It answers with your information; if it doesn't know something, it says so and hands over to a person.
en.faq.11: Is there a lock-in contract?
en.faq.12: No. Give us 30 days' notice and cancel, with no penalties. The website is yours. The domain is included for the first year; after that it renews annually.
en.faq.13: Does it work for my industry?
en.faq.14: Most likely, yes: clinics, hair salons, law firms, real estate agencies, repair shops and more. Try the demos by industry.
en.contacto.2: Shall we talkabout your new website?
en.contacto.7: No obligation and no lock-in. We'll reply within 24 hours.
en.faq.4: It depends on your case: how many pages you need, whether you need booking, or how many people use the dashboard. Prices are published on our pricing page, no lock-in.
en.contacto.3: Tell us about your business and we'll recommend the plan that fits.

fr.faq.3: Combien coûte Core Spark Web ?
fr.faq.5: En combien de temps est-il opérationnel ?

fr.faq.7: Dois-je déjà avoir un site ?
